events.title: How The RPC (RES) Investment Story Is Shifting With New Assumptions And Updated Fair Value
events.body: RPC’s latest analyst update centers on a higher fair value estimate, with the modeled price target moving to $6.44 from $5.66. Street research links this roughly $1 shift to refreshed assumptions that bullish and bearish analysts interpret

events.title: Liberty Oilfield Services (LBRT) Q1 Earnings and Revenues Top Estimates
events.body: Liberty Oilfield Services (LBRT) delivered earnings and revenue surprises of +146.15% and +7.64%, respectively, for the quarter ended March 2026. Do the numbers hold clues to what lies ahead for the stock?
